keyFindings.text: `README.md:963` says the eleven agents are "mirrored for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Devin and Pi (`.<runtime>/agents/`)". That list omits two runtime agent trees that ship all eleven agents: `.dsh/agents/` (eleven `<name>.patch.yml` persona patches) and `.vibe/agents/` (eleven `<name>.toml` profiles). Both are documented as generated agent trees by their own runtime docs, so the README's mirror list is stale by two runtimes.
